claim: The three paginated getSubGroupsStream overloads still dereference modelSupplier.get() without a null check, so the same concurrent-delete NPE the PR fixes in getSubGroupsCount remains reachable, e.g. via GET /groups/{id}/children.

The regression test never joins the reader thread and does not check that it ran any request during the deletes, so it can pass without exercising the race, and an exception thrown in the reader's last in-flight request can be missed.
